summary: @mtobis Came across my college senior thesis about the Kyoto Protocol in '99 where I traced lobbyist donations (USA) and then suggested a strategic partnership with urbanites and Western small farms and ranchers because this organic food thing might be a thing and invest infrastructure in midwest to keep former union voters trending conservative as they age.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @mtobis Came across my college senior thesis about the Kyoto Protocol in '99 where I traced lobbyist donations (USA) and then suggested a strategic partnership with urbanites and Western small farms and ranchers because this organic food thing might be a thing and invest infrastructure in midwest to keep former union voters trending conservative as they age.....might have helped the electoral map
